notes: v1.37: Auto-update hardened against corrupted/AV-quarantined downloads. Streams to .partial file, verifies size match + MZ exe magic before swap. Keeps backup of current exe. Batch waits 3s for AV scan post-move, then verifies new exe stays alive 5s after launch — if it crashed (python311.dll missing etc.) auto-rolls back from backup. Diagnostic _qyt_update.log next to exe.
